==Flavor Text==

''Your skill in 'Herbs & Sprouts' has allowed you to determine that this particular Mushroom is a Waning rather than a Waxing Toadstool. The Waning Toadstool is significantly more poisonous than its more common cousin.''

==About==

All wild {{i|Waxing Toadstool}}s may actually be be a significantly more poisonous {{i|Waning Toadstool}} in disguise. When picking a Waxing Toadstool, if your {{i|Herbs & Sprouts}} proficiency is high enough, you may be able detect this. Additionally, with the [[Fungiculture]] Skill learned, grown by planting another Waning Toadstool in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting a Waning Toadstool there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Waning Toadstool can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}.

When boiled a Waning Toadstool will become a {{i|Boiled Waning Toadstool}}. '''CAUTION''' There is a high chance that even after boiling, a Waning Toadstool will still be poisonous. A Boiled Waning Toadstool, {{i|Boiled Waxing Toadstool}}, Waning Toadstool, and a Waxing Toadstool all count as a Waxing Toadstool when planting and in Food recipes.
